page.layout: One page with a decorative header and a title block: "IN COLLEGIO AMIRAL." with column heads "Oppidani." and "Agiarii.". Below is a table of years (left, outside the rules) and names in two columns, with rules between the rows. Bottom right is the catchword "Errata". No running head.
page.notes: The ornamental fleuron headpiece above the title and the small ornament below the table are decoration, not transcribed. The years are printed at the left of the table rows and are read as cells of the table. "Gerryt Crabbe" is read as "Crabbe" with reasonable confidence, but the second letter may be an R; "Scultes" is a doubtful reading. The two-line entries for 1599 are aligned by position, so the pairing of the names to the year is an inference. The left-column entry for 1597 ("Idem non sedit.") and 1596 have no right-hand entry.
